description: Header file defining classes and functions for capturing and replaying OpenGL frame calls in ANGLE project, including ParamCapture, ParamBuffer, CallCapture, ReplayContext, DataCounters, and FrameCapture.

classes.name: ParamCapture
classes.description: Represents a captured parameter with name, type, value, and associated data.

classes.name: ParamBuffer
classes.description: Buffer holding multiple ParamCapture instances, used for batching parameters of a call.

classes.name: CallCapture
classes.description: Represents a captured OpenGL call with associated parameters.

classes.name: ReplayContext
classes.description: Context for replaying captured calls, managing buffers and pointers.

classes.name: DataCounters
classes.description: Helper class for tracking unique IDs for local data variables.

classes.name: FrameCapture
classes.description: Main class for capturing, storing, and replaying frame calls in ANGLE.

methods.name: captureCall
methods.description: Captures a call with given context and call data.

methods.name: onEndFrame
methods.description: Finalizes frame capture at the end of a frame.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Returns whether frame capture is enabled.

methods.name: captureClientArraySnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of client array data.

methods.name: maybeCaptureClientData
methods.description: Conditionally captures client data based on call.

methods.name: ReplayCall
methods.description: Static method to replay a specific call.

methods.name: getAndIncrement
methods.description: Gets and increments a counter for a specific call and parameter name.

methods.name: addValueParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter with a value to the buffer.

methods.name: addEnumParam
methods.description: Adds an enum parameter to the buffer.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a ParamCapture to a stream.

methods.name: CaptureMemory
methods.description: Captures memory data into a ParamCapture.

methods.name: CaptureString
methods.description: Captures a string into a ParamCapture.

methods.name: GetLinkedProgramForCapture
methods.description: Retrieves a linked program for capture purposes.

methods.name: WriteParamValueToStream
methods.description: Serializes parameter values to a stream based on type.
